Stanley M Herzog Charitable Foundation.prototype: Stanley M Herzog Charitable Foundation is a Missouri foundation giving across the country whose giving goes largely to schools, colleges, and universities and to churches and ministries. Cumulative giving is led by Second Baptist School Foundation with $50,000,000 over the period, followed by VELA Education Fund and Hebron Christian Academy. Across 2020 through 2024 it has made 204 grants totaling about $250.3 million, most between $2,500 and $398,000. A few very large commitments dominate that total, while the everyday grant stays far smaller. The giving is spread across many states, with Missouri, Texas, Virginia, and Iowa all represented. It funds both familiar and first-time recipients, with 42 of 204 grants renewing a prior recipient and new names on every return. It reports that it accepts unsolicited applications. A grant seeker who fits this giving pattern can approach directly.
